summary: Barracks & Bunk Assignment System testing complete. All 20 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Barracks overview shows 5 barracks cards with occupancy stats, open bay layout displays 25 bunks (13 left wall, 12 right wall), participant picker works with search/filter, bunk assignment/unassignment works correctly. Check-In step renamed from 'Room Assignment' to 'Bunk Assignment'. Admin page role dropdown includes all 5 support cadre roles.
seed_data_creation: Using existing data: 1 participant (Aben, Jeremy) assigned to TR-142B bunk 1 top. 98 unassigned participants available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Barracks & Bunk Assignment System fully implemented and tested. 5 barracks (TR-142B, TR-143A, TR-143B, TR-144A, TR-144B) each with 25 bunks (13 left wall, 12 right wall), 50 capacity. Check-in step renamed to bunk_assignment. Support cadre roles (support_logistics, support_comms, support_pa, support_dining, support_health) available in admin role dropdown.
